Oracle Layoffs: 1000-1500 Employees in India Could Be Affected by Fresh Job Cuts

Enterprise software giant Oracle began a new round of workforce reductions in India this week, targeting mid- and senior-level employees primarily across its web development and maintenance divisions, according to people familiar with the matter.
